t: A design project for a paper toolkit that teaches how neural networks use weights.
steps: Find the Sigmoid article dated September 18, 2019.
Read how the input and output machine works.
Note that the article does not say how to get the toolkit.
Gather paper, tubes or pipes and a paper ball to make a rough version.
Test the machine yourself before class.
Plan how students will change the weights.
Ask the vendor or author for the toolkit if you want the original.
